description: This file sets up a Streamlit web app that integrates a SQL database with an OpenAI language model to create an interactive chatbot capable of handling database queries and general conversation. It includes environment configuration, database connection, LLM and agent setup, a prompt template for user interactions, and a token counting function with a chat interface.

classes.name: traceable
classes.description: A decorator for tracing function calls, imported from langsmith.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: A function that combines a prompt template with a user query, runs it through a chain, and tracks token usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that initializes and runs the Streamlit app, handling user input and chatbot responses.
